messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary pool 'eu-canary-2' healthcheck failure threshold breached (3m) — elevated 5xx rate, abort criteria met. Trigger: rollout v2.14.3 -> canary. Pager sent to oncall.

maria: I'm on it. I'm seeing the alert — canary 5xx at ~18% over the last 3m, baseline ~0.2%. Paging devon (oncall).

devon: here. thanks. can anyone post the grafana link and recent deploy artifact ID?

sam: grafana -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd123/canary-overview?orgId=1&var-pool=eu-canary-2

sam: deploy artifact: rwinf-server:v2.14.3 (sha: 5f8c2a)

maria: quick checks: /healthz is failing on ~60% of hosts in eu-canary-2. Logs show repeated 500s with "GPU OOM while allocating KV cache" and downstream 502s from runtime-proxy.

devon: OOM on canary GPUs after new kernel selection — matches the new compilation path in v2.14.3. Abort criteria in play: 5xx > 5% for >2m -> auto-abort recommendation.

tori: @devon can we flip the canary routing kill-switch? I can run the flag flip if you want me to.

devon: please do. We'll also open a rollback, but kill-switch first to stop user traffic.

tori: running command now:
```
redwood-admin routes set-weight --route=default-eu --pool=eu-canary-2 --weight=0 --force
redwood-admin flags set feature.canary_route.enabled false --env=prod
```

tori: submitted. waiting for propagation (~20s).

sam: infra: noticed autoscaler tried to add one more GPU pod, it crashed on start with OOM before coming healthy.

ben: flipping routing worked — traffic to eu-canary-2 dropped to ~0.1% of previous. 5xx rate across prod dropped from 3.4% -> 0.12% in the last minute.

maria: confirming healthchecks now showing hosts in canary as "unhealthy" which is expected. No new user traffic hitting bad pods.

devon: initiating rollback of the canary artifact from v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2 for eu region only. Command:
```
redwood-deploy rollback --pool eu-canary-2 --from 5f8c2a --to 4b9d1e --wait
```

devon: rollback in progress. ETA ~3-6m.

sam: opening an incident record: INC-2026-0315-047 in pagerduty with tags [canary, rollback, eu]

maria: customer-impact check: CS reports a handful of elevated error reports from EU customers using long streaming responses (they hit retry/backoff and most requests succeeded). No broad outage. We'll mark severity P2 for now.

ben: rollback finished on eu-canary-2. Verify: running checks — 5xx <= 0.3%, healthz back to normal on v2.14.2 instances.

devon: good. leaving the canary pool drained and flagged disabled. I'll follow up with a post-rollback sanity sweep (latency, token accounting) and coordinate a patch to the compilation selection.

tori: handing off to morning oncall (maria) for postmortem follow-up and customer comms. summary: canary v2.14.3 caused GPU OOMs -> elevated 5xx -> kill-switch flipped + rollback to v2.14.2 -> traffic normalized. duration ~14m from first alert to rollback completion.

maria: noted. I'll own the follow-up: create postmortem draft, include root cause analysis and mitigation (strict pre-launch GPU memory tests, fail-safe kernels), and draft customer note. tagging @devon and @sam for technical details.

devon: thanks. any PRs or CI gates we want immediate? I propose adding a canary mem-pressure test and lowering canary traffic threshold for kernel-level changes.

maria: agreed. Also adding a temporary guard in the compilation service to avoid the problematic kernel on older card families until patched.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Incident INC-2026-0315-047 status -> mitigated. Timeline and notes will be appended when postmortem is posted.

maria: closing this thread — will attach postmortem link once ready. :white_check_mark:
